name: Nanjing Gaoke Company Limited
summary: Nanjing Gaoke Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of real estate properties in China. The company designs and develops mid-to-high-end commercial housing, municipal, and landscape projects; and provides water pollution prevention and control services, as well as provides financing guarantees. It also involves in the industrial investment, venture capital, securities investment, investment management and consulting, and other investment activities; and provision of financing services for small and medium-sized technology companies, and start-up businesses.
